scenarios.situation: A written policy says that every release needs a second reviewer.
The release system refuses to publish a release that has no recorded approval from a second reviewer.
A scanner lists every dependency with a known advisory in a report. Nothing is stopped.
When a configuration drifts from the approved one, a job restores the approved configuration.
The release system refuses to publish unless the scanner's report shows no known advisory.
A policy requires scanning, and the scanner reported no advisory. Claim: no vulnerable dependency can be released.
The release system refuses to publish without approval, but an administrator can override the refusal. Claim: no unapproved release can ever happen.
A setting requires the scanner's result before publishing. No publication has been observed to be refused or admitted under it. Claim: the setting prevents vulnerable releases.
